title: Public capital money by funding stream

rows.name: Restaurant-meal and ticket taxes, alone or pooled with hotel taxes
General taxes, general-obligation bonds, appropriations, state grants and sales of public assets
Tax increment and other tax capture
Lease-revenue bonds backed by the general fund or parking
Public money not split among its funding streams
Land contributed or sold below value
Infrastructure and site work, funding stream not stated

method: select g.bucket, g.name, g.payer, g.ord, sum(b.public_2026_m) as public_2026_m, 100 * sum(b.public_2026_m) / (select sum(public_2026_m) from capital) as share_pct from buckets b join capital c using (item_id) join bucket_groups g using (bucket) group by all order by g.ord
